svg.title: Match Query Profile symptoms to a first investigation
svg.desc: For queues inspect overload, provisioning, or blocking. For large spills reduce intermediate data or increase resources. For weak pruning check selective predicates and data layout. For exploding joins check keys and grain. Measure correctness and performance afterward.

g.text: Find the bottleneck before choosing a feature
Query History → Query Profile / Insights → expensive operator
Concurrency fixes differ from startup or lock fixes.
Reduce intermediate data; assess memory capacity.
Check SQL, batch size, and warehouse size.
Compare scanned partitions with needed rows.
Review selectivity and data layout for repeated patterns.
Check join condition, duplicate keys, and data grain.
Find the reason for unexpected row multiplication.
Change one thing → compare results, runtime, and credits on representative work.
